system.description:
A master of advanced systems, experimental tools, and battlefield engineering.

Scanning Array: Detect technological signatures and exotic energy patterns within Close range. You know whether an object is powered, dormant, or offline.

System Patch: Once per session, gain a Charge and place it on a Tech card within Close range, or suppress a malfunction or glitch effect until the end of the scene.

Overload the System: Once per long rest, vault a Tech card from your loadout. Either gain Charges equal to its level and distribute them among charge-storing cards, or return an equal-or-lower-level Tech card from your vault to your loadout.

Hope Feature - Energy Surge: Spend 3 Hope to gain 2 Charge tokens on a card that can store Charges.

Class Items: A set of modular tools or a portable power cell.
backgroundQuestions: Who first showed you how to bend technology beyond its intended purpose?
What ambitious design remains half-finished in your workshop?
What guiding principle shapes every system you build?
connections: You once helped me test a prototype in the field. What went wrong?
I built something specifically for you. What is it, and why do you still rely on it?
You know how much I have changed since the accident. Why do you never mention it?

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind
